nodes.name: Run Pipeline
nodes.notes: Set PIPELINE_DIR in n8n's environment variables to the absolute path of zwk-affiliate-pipeline/ on your server.

nodes.name: Notify Success

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: '✅ ZWK pipeline completed at ' + $now.toISO() + '. New production queue ready in data/matched/.' }) }}

nodes.notes: Set WEBHOOK_SUCCESS_URL in n8n env vars (Slack incoming webhook, Discord webhook, etc.). Delete this node if you don't need notifications.

nodes.name: Notify Failure

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: '❌ ZWK pipeline FAILED at ' + $now.toISO() + '. Output:\n' + $('Run Pipeline').item.json.stdout }) }}

nodes.notes: Set WEBHOOK_FAILURE_URL in n8n env vars. Can be a different channel/recipient from success notifications.

_instructions.import: In n8n: Settings → Workflows → Import from file → select this JSON.

env_vars_required.PIPELINE_DIR: Absolute path to the zwk-affiliate-pipeline/ directory on your n8n server. Example: /home/ubuntu/zero-waste-kitchen/zwk-affiliate-pipeline
env_vars_required.WEBHOOK_SUCCESS_URL: (Optional) Slack/Discord incoming webhook URL for success notifications.
env_vars_required.WEBHOOK_FAILURE_URL: (Optional) Slack/Discord incoming webhook URL for failure notifications.

_instructions.prerequisites: Node.js ≥18 must be installed on the n8n server. Run `npm install` in PIPELINE_DIR once before activating this workflow.
